headline: KISSHT issues corrigendum to extraordinary general meeting notice
hook: Notice correction for an upcoming meeting
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited, operating under the brand KISSHT, has issued a corrigendum regarding the notice for its extraordinary general meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026. Such corrections are typically procedural updates to previously circulated meeting documents. For Indian retail investors, routine procedural filings by unlisted or private subsidiaries of broader networks generally have negligible immediate impact on stock prices or market sentiment.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for public retail investors.

headline: Onemi Technology Solutions posts 68.4% YoY AUM growth in Q2FY27
hook: Strong growth in assets under management
summary: Onemi Technology Solutions reported a 68.4 percent year-on-year increase in its assets under management for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The financial technology firm saw notable expansion in its lending portfolio during the period. Retail investors tracking fintech lenders can assess the company's scaling pace relative to industry peers.
why_it_matters: Reflects scaling pace of unlisted fintech lenders

headline: KISSHT issues provisional business update for Q2 FY27
hook: Provisional numbers for the September quarter
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited, the parent company of digital lending platform Kissht, has released its provisional business update on a consolidated basis for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company informed the stock exchanges regarding the press release dated October 3, 2026. These early operational figures give a preliminary look into the fintech firm's quarterly performance before audited financial results are published. Retail investors tracking digital lenders can gauge early credit growth trends from these numbers.
whats_next: Audited financial results for the quarter
why_it_matters: Early gauge of digital lending growth trends.

headline: Kisst issuer OnEMI Technology notifies exchange of litigation
hook: Standard disclosure filed by OnEMI Technology
summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited, the company behind the Kissht brand, has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding ongoing litigation or disputes under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The filing serves as a routine procedural compliance disclosure to keep market participants informed about legal proceedings affecting the entity. For Indian retail investors, litigation updates from fintech platforms warrant attention regarding potential contingent liabilities or operational headwinds.
why_it_matters: Legal disputes at fintech lenders could impact borrowing costs and asset quality.
